name: MACH Discovery Lab
description: Independent lab-only service-agent shell for studying agent discovery, tool selection and communication. It does not execute MACH production services.

skills.name: Discover capability
skills.description: Find matching lab-only capabilities from a local static catalog.

skills.name: Quote capability
skills.description: Return local catalog price and latency metadata.

skills.name: Sandbox probe
skills.description: Run a deterministic local fixture. Never calls production.

skills.name: Report outcome
skills.description: Record structured local feedback about discovery or probe outcomes.
